research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Rebellyous Foods is researching food manufacturing technology focused on processing and hydrating foodstuff materials and automated meat analogue production. Foodstuff processing apparatus and foodstuff hydration and processing system describe exterior tubes, inner shafts, protrusions and water inlets to control conveyance and mixing. Hydration systems with adjustable agitation features and asymmetric fluted infeeds refine flow, while automated meat analogue production systems improve continuous formation of meat alternatives. Together these show work on foodstuff processing, hydration, and automated analogue production.

overview_description.description:
Rebellyous Foods is a food manufacturing technology and production company defined solely to catapult meat alternative production toward price parity with animal-based meat. Rebellyous Foods implements food manufacturing equipment and processes in large-scale production to produce low-cost plant-based meat at high volumes. These goals are achieved through uniquely designed food products, the use of high-throughput manufacturing automation and ‘smart’ production centers, and the development and utilization of new innovative low-energy manufacturing tools.

Rebellyous Foods was established in 2017 in Seattle, Washington.
